question: How sensitive is the descriptive late-versus-on-time poor-rating contrast to unavailable post-delivery ratings?
review_policy: first answer at or after delivery and at or before the window endpoint; answer strictly before observation cutoff; ties: creation timestamp, review ID, score ascending, nulls last
cohort_policy: same cohort for every window; delivered status, positive item GMV, customer identity, valid actual/promised dates, purchase from start, delivery plus maximum window strictly before cutoff
missing_outcome_policy: unavailable within-window ratings remain unknown, never assigned a good score
interpretation: descriptive association and hypothetical full-rating sensitivity; no causal effect, no proof of missing-at-random, no current-business claim
